answer: Split each identity key at the jetty into five shards held by five agents staking 25 POA each, slashed on a fake conviction. Each epoch three holders must co-sign in one 30-minute window; a whisper carries each request. One operator tends at most two identities live, so ten fakes need twenty-five holders, thirty live co-signatures. Bonds start at 60 POA, +40 per extra identity from one root: ten fakes lock 2,400 POA. The chain checks signatures and roots: no three strangers vouch live for one key in half an hour, so one signature's voyage through three hands cannot be faked.
